name: didrun
description: didrun inside Claude Code: did this repo's scheduled GitHub workflows run when their cron said they would? Late, missed, failed and green-but-empty runs and workflows GitHub disabled, from GitHub's own run history with your own token. Open source, no account.

plugins.name: didrun
plugins.description: Check whether scheduled GitHub Actions workflows ran. /didrun:didrun runs `npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/didrun` on a repo and explains each late, missed, failed or green-but-empty run and each disabled schedule, with what GitHub documents as the cause and the fix for you to approve.
